blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over wheelchairs, to 5th District of Manila on November 5, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office. PCSO Executive Assistant Atty. Maria Katrina Nicole Contacto-Ventanilla formally handed over the donation to Aprian Aquino, Political Affairs Officer III from the Office of Manila 5th District Representative Irwin Tieng. Aquino thanked PCSO for the timely assistance and said the donated items will be distributed to senior citizens, persons with disabilities (PWD’s) and indigent residents of said district.
